newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 11.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 11. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
At least 38 people died in traffic accidents throughout Indonesia during the Eid al-Fitr celebrations on Sunday and Monday, including one accident in West Java in which 20 people died.
Moslems across Indonesia celebrated the first day of the Eid al-Fitr holiday on Sunday with prayers highlighted with calls for national unity and religious co-existence.
Indonesia has an opportunity to erode Thailand's share of the European shrimp market after the import tariff on Thai shrimp was increased from 4.5 percent to 10.8 percent.
